name: Ezekiel
modDescription: A holy warrior wielding Spirit Sword, Holy Light, Sacred Heart, and divine wrath birthright!
birthright: Holy Radiance: Full health grants holy light beams and extra sword range on every slash.

name: Samus
modDescription: The Intergalactic Bounty Hunter equipped with Tech X plasma rings, heavy missiles, Morph Ball jump, and Varia Suit!
birthright: Varia Suit: Grants permanent explosion immunity, hazard absorption, and +15% charge speed.

name: Donkey Kong
modDescription: The King of the Jungle! Heavy coconut punches, banana binge eating, and seismic ground stomps.
birthright: Jungle Beat: Stomping enemies triggers room-wide tremors and spawns golden bananas (+2 damage).

name: Cardcaptor Sakura
modDescription: The magical Clow Card master wielding Godhead, Blank Card, Star of Bethlehem, and celestial wings.
birthright: Release the Seal!: Using cards releases glowing celestial wings, granting flight and 3 homing star familiars.

name: Chainsmoker Cat
modDescription: A gritty neon feline with a red-hot cigarette tip, 9 lives, toxic smoke screen, and Guppy fly swarms.
birthright: Nicotine Rush: Room clears grant a +50% speed burst and leave a dense smoke cloud that blinds all enemies.

name: Grimm
modDescription: A skeletal warrior wielding bone clubs, Compound Fracture bone shatters, Book of the Dead, and a chained phantom Soul!
birthright: Soul Release: The Soul breaks free from the skeletal chain to freely roam, shoot spectral tears, and shield the Forgotten.
